customer_jane: Hey @support, hitting "input token limit exceeded" on /v1/rerank but payload seems small? Sending 1 query + ~120 docs (many HTML dumps). any ideas? :confused:

sarah_support: Hi Jane — can you paste the exact error body and HTTP status? also which model/endpoint and a redacted curl would help.

customer_jane: It's a 400 with message:
"token limit exceeded: 51200 tokens"
Model: redwood-rerank-v1. Docs are long HTML strings, suspect tokenization is bigger than bytes.

customer_jane: Example curl (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"<very long user query text...>", "documents":[{"id":"d1","text":"<...>"}, {"id":"d2","text":"<...>"}, ...]}'
```

miguel_eng: tagging @sarah_support @alex_docs — quick diagnosis: rerank enforces a per-request token ceiling (currently 51200 tokens) calculated over query + all document texts + overhead. HTML + scripts and embedded base64 blow token counts quickly. This is a per-request safety/latency cap, not the monthly billing quota.

alex_docs: Agreed we should return which field pushed the count over and the actual token tally in the error payload. Right now the wording is opaque and customers assume billing tier controls it. I'll draft a KB page: https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits (placeholder).

sarah_support: Customer says they were billed for the failed requests — can billing confirm if failed calls are chargeable? @billing_team? (cc @miguel_eng)

miguel_eng: Per infra, we meter request attempts but we should confirm the billing policy. Functionally: 1) this is per-request limit independent of plan; 2) Dedicated/Enterprise can request higher per-request caps via an agreement.

customer_jane: Workarounds? We can't change upstream document generation easily.

miguel_eng: Short-term options: truncate/strip HTML before sending, extract passages server-side and send only top K passages, or pre-filter with embeddings to reduce candidates. Also we can recommend sending smaller batches of docs (e.g., 20-30 docs per rerank call).

miguel_eng: Quick helper pseudo-snippet:
```
# greedy trim by token budget (pseudocode)
def trim_docs(docs, token_budget, tokenizer):
    kept = []
    remaining = token_budget
    for d in docs:
        t = tokenizer.count(d['text'])
        if t <= remaining:
            kept.append(d)
            remaining -= t
        else:
            # keep a prefix or summary
            kept.append({'id': d['id'], 'text': tokenizer.truncate(d['text'], remaining)})
            break
    return kept
```

sarah_support: I'll send the customer step-by-step: strip scripts, convert HTML->plaintext, send <=30 docs, or do a preliminary embedding filter. Also asking PM/eng to improve error UX to include token_count and field breakdown. @miguel_eng can you file an eng ticket? :pray: 

miguel_eng: Filed ENG-4789 to surface token counts in errors and suggest actionable fixes (truncate, chunk, pre-filter). ETA TBD.

support-bot: Created support ticket #12345 for billing & limit follow-up.

customer_jane: Thanks — one more thing: they expected the per-request limit to scale with plan. please clarify to avoid future surprises.

alex_docs: I'll draft a KB titled "How rerank token limits work (query + docs)" with examples showing tokenization differences and a small token-check snippet customers can run pre-send.

customer_jane: Appreciate it — will try truncation and report back. :thumbsup:
__notes: Thread about per-request token limits on rerank, repro steps, billing confusion, suggested mitigations and engineering follow-up. Keeps messages short and Slack-like.
